title: Branson Fish Tales
specs: Table Rock Lake is one of the top bass fishing lakes in North America with abundant bass and other species
Lake Taneycomo is known for being one of the finest trout fishing lakes in the world
Non-residents 16 years and older must purchase a non-resident fishing license
Residents of Missouri 65 years and older are not required to purchase a fishing license
Anglers 15 years old and younger are not required to purchase a license regardless of residency
All anglers fishing for trout are required to purchase a trout stamp regardless of age or residency
Maximum 6 people for trout fishing trips
Maximum 4 people for bass fishing trips

blurb: Guests fish for bass on Table Rock Lake and trout on Lake Taneycomo with Captain Shane Pierce. The lakes offer abundant bass, crappie, white bass, catfish, bluegill, rainbow trout, and brown trout. The guide service provides personalized fishing trips to maximize the fishing experience.
extraNote: A 4% fee will be added to all credit card transactions · Located in Hollister MO, minutes from Ridgedale MO and Branson MO
